provider: Microsoft 365 / Office 365 A1 Education tenant (100 TB pooled)

free_tier.stated: 100 TB (102,400 GB) free pooled storage per education tenant, spanning OneDrive + SharePoint + Exchange; pooled capacity = 100 TB base + per-license contributions. Office 365 A1 licenses contribute 0 GB but consume from the pool.
free_tier.notes: Headline offer; binding constraint specified in limits.

per_object_cap.stated: No per-object cap documented in published terms; absence is not an unlimited claim.
per_object_cap.notes: extraction found no per-object clause; some of these providers meter on object count rather than bytes, and some state no cap

retention.stated: No retention statement documented in published terms; absence is not an unlimited claim.
retention.notes: No retention clause documented in available terms.

egress.terms: Not metered. Microsoft 365 is a subscription service with no per-GB egress meter; Microsoft support states 'if the user has the related license, there is no charge for uploading and downloading files'. SharePoint/OneDrive downloads are direct HTTPS URLs.

tooling: Microsoft Graph driveItem API (whole-tenant app-only auth: Files.ReadWrite.All + Sites.Read.All); rclone backend 'onedrive' with drive_type=business or drive_type=documentLibrary, and a SharePoint remote type; office365-rest-python-client (vgrem) for list/library operations
chaining: 100 TB is per TENANT and tenants are per institution, not per user: N schools x 100 TB. Inside one tenant the ceiling is much higher than the pool in principle - 2,000,000 site collections per org at up to 25 TB per site - but the 100 TB pool is the binding limit. Add unlimited free A1 user licenses (which add 0 GB but give each user a 100 GB or 1 TB OneDrive ceiling), and paid A3/A5 at 50/100 GB per license. Multiply across tenants for archival shards.
limits_note: Office 365 A1 OneDrive = 100 GB/user hard max (set Feb 2024); Microsoft 365 A1 OneDrive = up to 1 TB/user, capped by the same 100 TB pool. 250 GB max single file upload. 50,000 major versions / 511 minor per file - versioning silently duplicates storage on overwrite, so use a Communication site with versioning disabled. 25 TB max per site collection. Tenant goes read-only when over pool.

reliability_note: Storage is enforced at the tenant pool level and tenants get flipped to read-only on overage - data survives but writes fail; per-user OneDrive caps were cut (5 TB -> 100 GB for A1) in 2024 with no migration path.
